meta.title: JIANOVA
meta.description: A Saudi footwear technology project creating premium running shoes and an innovative digital shopping experience. In development.

hero.title: Redefining the running experience.
hero.intro: JIANOVA is a Saudi footwear technology project creating premium running shoes, and a better way to make them yours.
hero.placeholderNote: Shown: a simplified placeholder model. The final JIANOVA shoe is still in design.

vision.heading: Vision
vision.text: To combine premium footwear design, modern technology, and personalization into one seamless experience.

status.heading: Where we are
status.text: JIANOVA is in development. We are designing our first running shoe, and building the 3D configurator you can already try with a placeholder model.

configurator.title: Design your pair
configurator.intro: Choose a part, then a color. Changes appear on the shoe right away.
configurator.placeholderNote: This is a simplified placeholder model for trying the configurator. The final JIANOVA shoe is still in design.
configurator.hint: Drag to turn the shoe, scroll or pinch to zoom, and click a part to select it.
configurator.stageLabel: 3D view of the running shoe with your chosen colors
configurator.unavailable: The 3D view could not be shown on this device. You can still choose colors below.
